import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();
        
        int m = n * (n - 1) / 2;
        int maxRange = n * (n - 1) + 1;
        
        // Using long for DP to prevent overflow during intermediate additions
        long[][] dp = new long[n + 1][maxRange + 1];
        long[][] dp1 = new long[n + 1][maxRange + 1];
        
        if (n >= 1) {
            dp[1][m] = 1;
        }
        
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            int prevMin = m - (i - 1) * (i - 2) / 2;
            int prevMax = m + (i - 1) * (i - 2) / 2;
            for (int x = prevMin; x <= prevMax; x++) {
                if (x < 0 || x >= maxRange) continue;
                long val = dp[i - 1][x];
                if (val == 0) continue;
                for (int d = -i + 1; d < i; d++) {
                    int nextX = x + d;
                    if (nextX >= 0 && nextX <= maxRange) {
                        dp[i][nextX] = (dp[i][nextX] + val * (i - Math.abs(d))) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            int prevMin = m - (i - 1) * (i - 2) / 2;
            int prevMax = m + (i - 1) * (i - 2) / 2;
            for (int x = prevMin; x <= prevMax; x++) {
                if (x < 0 || x >= maxRange) continue;
                dp1[i][x] = (dp1[i - 1][x] * i) % mod;
            }
            for (int x = prevMin; x <= prevMax; x++) {
                if (x < 0 || x >= maxRange) continue;
                long val = dp[i - 1][x];
                if (val == 0) continue;
                for (int d = 1; d < i; d++) {
                    int nextX = x - d;
                    if (nextX >= 0 && nextX <= maxRange) {
                        dp1[i][nextX] = (dp1[i][nextX] + val * (i - d)) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int x = m + 1; x <= maxRange; x++) {
            ans = (ans + dp1[n][x]) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
